findings: The historical split balances entity presence but not values, domains, formatting families, templates, regions, or generators.
Only 44 of 163,740 official English training rows contain no PII, so hard-negative coverage is effectively absent.
The official English training distribution contains only seven email domains.
Lowercase names are virtually absent even though the deployed tokenizer is uncased; controlled minimal pairs are required to separate tokenizer invariance from context and surface-family effects.
Thirteen project-training labels have fewer than 100 spans and must not receive unsupported performance claims.
